test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Padma Awardee 2021, Anshu Jamsenpa, has received the award for her illustrious achievements in which of the following fields?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mountaineering**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Padma Awardee 2021,** **Anshu Jamsenpa**, has received the award for her illustrious achievements in Mountaineering.
 
• **Anshu Jamsenpa**, hailing from Bomdila in Arunachal Pradesh, holds the distinction of being the first woman in the world to scale the **summit of Mount Everest twice in a single season**.
 
• She achieved this feat while also becoming the fastest double summitter, accomplishing it within a remarkable five-day period.
 
• Jamsenpa is the sole woman to achieve the fastest double ascents of the highest peak in the world.
 
• She holds the distinction of being the first Indian woman to scale Mount Everest five times and is also the first woman and mother to complete double ascents twice.
 
• Recognizing her extraordinary achievements, Jamsenpa was honoured with the Padma Shri, the fourth-highest civilian award in India, in 2021. Her remarkable journey began on May 12, 2011, when she first stood atop Mount Everest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• During the** 2013 North East India Everest Expedition**, led by **Surjit Singh Leishangthem, Anshu Jamsenpa **successfully summited Mount Everest, achieving the rare honor of standing atop the** 8,848-meter peak**.
 
• Recognizing her remarkable achievement, the Arunachal Pradesh government recommended her name for the prestigious Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award. On September 25, 2018, President Ram Nath Kovind conferred upon Jamsenpa the nation’s highest adventure award for 2017.
 
• Jamsenpa's accolades extend beyond national recognition. She was awarded the Woman Achiever of the Year 2011-12 by the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI) in Guwahati in June 2012.
 
• She received the CNN-IBN Young Indian Leader Award a year prior. In 2017, the Arunachal Pradesh government honoured her with the Tourism Icon of the Year Award. Furthermore, for her exceptional contributions to adventure sports, Jamsenpa was conferred with a PhD by the Arunachal University of Studies.
